title: Meal acquisition / venue taxonomy
principle: Acquisition is where/how the meal was obtained. It is NOT a quality or NOVA score. A quick-service salad can be high quality; a home UPF tray can be low quality.
anti_patterns: Do not set nova_class from acquisition alone
Do not map quick_service → ultra_processed automatically
Do not use chain names as medical claims

acquisition.label: Home prepared
acquisition.description: Cooked or assembled at home from ingredients.

acquisition.label: Home assembled from packages
acquisition.description: Opened bags/boxes/jars at home (cereal, frozen pizza, meal kit).
acquisition.demo_use: UPF at home — shows venue ≠ quality

acquisition.label: Grocery / deli counter
acquisition.description: Prepared foods from supermarket deli or salad bar.

acquisition.label: Quick service / fast food
acquisition.description: Counter or drive-thru QSR. Menu can include salads, grilled items, or classic combos.
acquisition.note: FAST FOOD lives here as context only.

acquisition.label: Fast casual
acquisition.description: Bowl/assembly lines, limited table service (e.g. Chipotle-class). Often higher whole-food option density than classic QSR, still out-of-home.

acquisition.label: Convenience / gas / vending
acquisition.description: Gas station, corner store, vending — often packaged, not always.

qsr_path_tags.description: Optional path tags when acquisition is quick_service or fast_casual. Still not quality scores.

tags.label: Salad / veg-forward path
tags.description: User chose salad, bowl, grilled protein + veg — possible high-quality QSR meal.

tags.label: Grilled protein path
tags.description: Grilled chicken/fish sandwich or plate without deep-fry default.

tags.label: Classic combo path
tags.description: Burger/nuggets + fries + sugary drink pattern — often high NOVA/HP risk, still judge packet.

tags.label: Fried-default path
tags.description: Nuggets, fries, fried sandwich as core.

tags.label: Sweet drink add-on
tags.description: Soda/shake co-load; can raise HP-1/sugar without changing entrée quality.

tags.label: Path unknown
tags.description: Venue known, order path not classified.

chain_hint.description: Optional coarse chain class for demos — never a health ranking.
chain_hint.note: Prefer generic_* over real brand names in seed data unless barcode is real product.

order: 2. Score packet: NOVA, matrix, density, oils, sugars, HP-1/HP-2
3. Optional coach copy: 'Even at a drive-thru, this salad path looks different from the combo path'
engine_hooks: persona Casey (time-poor) — acquisition friction, not moral failure
